description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointed Mr. S. M. S. Jayawardena as the arbitrator for the Settlement of Industrial Disputes between 223 Employees including Mr. Hewagama and Southern Provincial Road Development Authority and between Mr. B. D. Gunawardena and Southern Provincial Road Development Authority and Mr. Sarath Liyanage between Mrs. C. K. Jayawardena and State Pharmaceuticals Corporation of Sri Lanka and Revocation of the Order made to appoint Mr. V. Vimalarajah as the arbitrator to the Industrial Dispute between Mr. A. W. N. Harischandra Waduge and Sri Lanka Transport Board and appointed Mr. S. Kariyawasam as the arbitrator
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the exercise of powers under the Industrial Disputes Act (a specific law) to appoint an arbitrator for an industrial dispute. It references legislative enactments, amendments to acts, and contains a formal legal order issued by the Minister. The core subject matter is the application of a legal/regulatory framework to resolve a dispute, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While a government minister is named, the notice is about executing a legal function, not about the minister's appointment, portfolio responsibilities, or a government structural change.
